ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the provided document:  BF Utilities Limited has filed its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. However, the publication of its consolidated financial results is significantly delayed because two major subsidiaries, Nandi Infrastructure Corridor Enterprise Ltd. (NICE) and Nandi Economic Corridor Enterprises Ltd. (NECE), have not yet submitted their financial data to the parent company. This inability of subsidiaries to provide timely financial information to the parent is a material red flag, suggesting potential issues with internal controls, governance, or transparency within the group, and prevents investors from gaining a complete financial overview.
